title: Niagara Falls hotels with a falls view: which room to book
metaDescription: Five hotels on Fallsview Boulevard with rooms that face Niagara Falls, the exact room category to book, and the river view and city view rooms to skip.
h1: Niagara Falls hotels with a falls view, and which room to book
dek: Five hotels on the Canadian side, along Fallsview Boulevard. We list the categories that are sold with a view of the falls, and the river view, city view and courtyard rooms to skip.
teaser: Which rooms face the Horseshoe Falls, which the American Falls, and which see both.

decoder.text: At the Hilton, “US” rooms face the American Falls, “Canadian” rooms face the Horseshoe Falls, and “Canadian/US” rooms see both.
The Oakes and the Marriott Fallsview both sell river view rooms separately from their falls view rooms.
At the Oakes, only the Tower rooms are sold with a falls view. Courtyard rooms carry no view at all.

alternatives.title: Book a table instead
alternatives.text: No falls view room in the budget? The Hilton's Watermark restaurant is on the 33rd floor, with floor-to-ceiling views of the falls, according to TravelAwaits.

faq.q: What do Canadian Fallsview and US Fallsview mean?
faq.a: They tell you which falls the room faces. At the Hilton, Canadian rooms face the Horseshoe Falls, US rooms face the American Falls, and Canadian/US rooms see both.

faq.q: Do all rooms in a Fallsview hotel face the falls?
faq.a: No. Every hotel on this page also sells city view, river view or courtyard rooms. An address on Fallsview Boulevard is not a promise; the room name is.

faq.q: Which side of the border are these hotels on?
faq.a: All five are in Niagara Falls, Ontario, in Canada, on Fallsview Boulevard.
